his_statement: Common-refiner lifting forced by δ and least receiving strata.
statement: If Z refines compatible X,Y, take its least receiving faces X₀≤X,Y₀≤Y. If they were distinct exclusive faces, compatibility and stability of δ under immediate refinement would imply ZδZ, contradicting irreflexivity. Hence the receiving faces must be reconciled through a common face, yielding the stated common-refiner lifting. The argument uses δ-stability on both variables and the least, not merely a minimal, receiving face.
